name: fastapi-security-authentication-failure-policies
instr:
FastAPI cannot define reusable authentication-failure policies shared by request handling and OpenAPI documentation. Add policies that receive the request, concrete failing scheme, classified reason, effective OAuth scopes, and credential location or name, then deterministically select status, repeated headers, media type, and serializable body. Scheme policy overrides route policy, which overrides the application default, without cross-route state leakage. Without a policy, preserve constructors, successes, default failures, realm behavior, public security imports, and OpenAPI security ordering.

APIKeyQuery, APIKeyHeader, and APIKeyCookie report configured locations and names. Every HTTP authentication scheme classifies failures before policy rendering: HTTPBasic distinguishes absent authorization, wrong schemes, invalid base64, non-ASCII payloads, and missing username-password separators, while HTTPBearer and HTTPDigest distinguish missing authorization, incomplete authorization, and nonmatching schemes. OAuth2PasswordBearer and OAuth2AuthorizationCodeBearer report deduplicated effective scopes in first-seen dependency declaration order while preserving their distinct OpenAPI flows. OpenIdConnect applies policy only to absent authorization, passes every present value through unchanged, and retains its discovery URL and description. Optional schemes bypass policies and return None for absent or nonmatching credentials, preserving endpoint-visible results. Effective failures
